pill_bottle.label: Child-proof pill bottle

params.frame: object frame = CAD frame offset by transform; body spans z neck_z-body_h..neck_z (-58..17), cap neck_z..neck_z+cap_h (17..35)

pill_bottle.notes: Procedural (no STEP). Bottom fingers hold the body (d34), top fingers the cap (d38). Twist stroke 24.3 mm on r=19 turns the cap 73 deg, so 1.5 turns ~ 7.4 strokes; cap rises thread_pitch_mm per turn.

eye_dropper.label: Eye-drop bottle
eye_dropper.notes: Held inverted (rotation 180 about X; model z -> CAD z = 60 - z). CAD z: body base 60, body 60..12, shoulder 12..4, neck 4..-2, nozzle (node 'cap', d14 tapering to 4.5) -2..-27. Bottom layer (-16..16) holds the lower body + shoulder (max d24), top layer (16..48) squeezes the body (d24). Drops fall from the nozzle tip at z=-27.

pill_tube.label: Pill tube (team CAD)
pill_tube.notes: From 'Pill Tube.step'. Real size: body d38.6, base flange d43.6, cap d47.3-48.6 - the cap is wider than the CAD's 45.2 mm open gap (the real gripper opens ~52 mm), so the sim shows it scaled x0.85: body d32.8, cap d40.2. STEP is modelled cap-down: flipped 180 deg about X. Cap CAD z 26..38 (top fingers), body -25.6..24 (bottom fingers), with the top layer at halves 0.

top_layer_note: Objects are placed for the top layer at halves 0 (sim sets the halves 'grip' slot to 0). top_z_mm = contact band on the pad, mm above the top layer's bottom edge (CAD z 16).
